propositions: Generated JSON files (index.json, criterion-pins.json) lack any marker indicating they are derived, causing developers to edit the generated artifact instead of its source and fail drift gates

Nine derived/parity-gated surfaces exist in the codebase but there is no centralized documentation listing them, so authors must already know which files are generated to locate the regenerate command

The two JSON-format surfaces cannot carry comment-syntax banners like markdown files do, requiring a top-level `_generated_by` key as a self-identifying marker that must remain a fixed point through regeneration
Existing equality tests compare on-disk generated files against pure builder functions, and must be re-pointed to marker-bearing document-building functions to pass after markers are added

The marker implementation must be inert to downstream consumers: reserved keys must be filtered (load_catalog skips underscore-prefixed keys) and drift gates must compare the same structures as before

A centralized table in docs/README.md documenting all nine surfaces (five already bannered, two needing JSON markers, three hand-authored but gated) plus a new test validating the table against reality will prevent future staleness
